## Question
What decision, assumption, or unknown needs investigation?

## Context
What user problem and current source behavior prompted this? Include code paths and existing issues if available.

## Evidence needed
- [ ] Relevant source code and data flows
- [ ] Official documentation and supported/unsupported surfaces
- [ ] Privacy and security considerations
- [ ] Failure cases and data-quality limits
- [ ] Trade-offs and measurable evaluation criteria

## Research findings
Add verified observations with references. Clearly label hypotheses and gaps.

## Decision / follow-up
State the decision or explain why evidence is insufficient. Link proposed implementation issues; do not silently implement as part of research.

## Sensitive data
Use synthetic examples only. Never include credentials, transcripts, customer data, or private repository contents.
